summary: Ukrainian forces report capturing Novonikolaevka in Donetsk, while Russian strikes target logistics hubs and infrastructure. Western aid shortfalls and conscription evasion schemes emerge as critical issues.
key_points: Ukrainian fighters from the Center group liberated Novonikolaevka in Donetsk People's Republic. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32452)
Russian drones and missiles struck logistics centers in Brovary (near Kyiv) and logistics hubs in Russia's Tver region. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32448, @eRadarrua/105358)
US General Dynamics plant in Texas failed to produce 155mm shells for Ukraine despite $500M investment. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32446)
Polish MiG-29 transfer negotiations with Ukraine stalled over security concerns. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32457)
Over 165 Ukrainian teachers conscripted via fake private school employment scheme uncovered. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32455)
Russian PVO systems reported downing 221 Ukrainian drones in a single day. (Source: @tass_agency/390340)
Montenegrin yacht registry shows Ukrainians own 21 vessels, ranking fifth among foreign owners. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32469)

sections.threat_assessment: Russian forces maintain pressure through sustained drone and missile strikes on Ukrainian infrastructure, while conscription evasion schemes undermine military readiness. Western aid shortfalls risk prolonging conflict as Ukraine struggles to replace lost equipment.
sections.regional_response: Polish authorities block MiG-29 transfers to Ukraine citing security risks, while Russian officials investigate alleged poisoning of tourists in Antalya. Ukrainian officials continue reporting Western aid shortfalls and infrastructure damage from Russian strikes.
sections.intelligence_notes: Russian military relies heavily on drone strikes and logistics targeting, while Ukrainian forces focus on capturing key positions. Western aid delays and conscription evasion highlight systemic challenges for both sides. Economic warfare through energy exports and agricultural product seizures remains a critical Russian strategy.
